methods.name: MAAU-Net (MobileNetV2, ASPP, Attention Gate, U-Net)
methods.summary: MAAU-Net is a hybrid U-Net architecture that integrates a pre-trained MobileNetV2 encoder for feature extraction, an Atrous Spatial Pyramid Pooling (ASPP) module at the bottleneck to capture multi-scale contextual features, and attention gates at skip connections to filter irrelevant information. It performs binary segmentation of landslide and background areas.
methods.source: Affandi, A. K., Khakim, M. Y. N., Erni, Desiani, A., Sari, P., & Pratiwi, Y.
methods.verbatim: This study proposes a new architecture for landslide segmentation that produces more accurate results to help detect landslides early. It combines MobilNetV2, ASPP, and Attention Gate architectures with U-Net for landslide image segmentation, creating MAAU-Net (MobileNetV2, ASPP, Attention Gate, U-Net).

reproducibility_assessment: The landslide inventory datasets are referenced and linked, but the custom MAAU-Net code is not available via any repository or persistent link.
